body.text:
Implements an Android version of Audio Stamper under `android/` (resolving #8).

### Architecture
- **`:stamper-core`** (pure Kotlin/JVM): Ports `StamperCore` with `fm.teal.feed.play` record encoding, grapheme-safe 256-byte UTF-8 clamping, `ATProtoClient` (handle/DID resolution, App Password, and OAuth PKCE/PAR + ES256 DPoP with `DPoP-Nonce` handling and coalesced 401 refresh), `MusicBrainzClient` (1.1s rate-limited ISRC + release enrichment), `Deduplicator`, and `PlayPublisher` (per-account disk-backed retry queue).
- **`:app`** (Jetpack Compose + Material 3):
  - Dark + teal UI (`SignInScreen`, `ListeningScreen`, `SettingsScreen`)
  - Chrome Custom Tabs Atmosphere OAuth (`net.mmatt.audiostamper:/callback`) + App Password + manual PDS fallback
  - Android Keystore AES-256-GCM session storage (`SessionStore`)
  - Foreground microphone service (`ListeningService`, `foregroundServiceType="microphone"`) capturing 44.1 kHz mono PCM chunks with a pluggable `TrackRecognizer` (`AudDTrackRecognizer` configurable in Settings)

### Verification
- `./gradlew :stamper-core:test :app:assembleDebug` — all 17 unit tests pass and debug APK builds cleanly.
- Verified on Android 15.0 emulator (`webslicer_android35`): Atmosphere OAuth sign-in, callback deep-link handling, Settings, and active foreground microphone listening.
